//@version=6
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ //
//# * ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//# *
//# * Study       : Volume Profile & Market Activity (Fixed / Visible Range)
//# * Author      : © dgtrd
//# *
//# * Revision History
//# *  Release    : Feb 23, 2022
//# *  Update     : Feb 27, 2022 : added volume indicator (histogram)
//# *  Update     : Feb 28, 2022 : volume indicator now has a moving average option
//# *  Update     : Mar 10, 2022 : horizontal offset option added, applicable for volume profile placed on right side
//# *  Update     : Mar 15, 2022 : added sentiment profile 
//# *  Update     : Apr 09, 2022 : aesthetic tweaks 
//# *  Update     : Apr 25, 2022 : value area addition
//# *  Update     : Jul 13, 2022 : visible range option added, thanks to pine latest update
//# *  Update     : Jan 05, 2024 : core functionality enhancements and new features addition
//# *  Update     : Jan 13, 2024 : stats addition
//# *  Update     : Mar 16, 2026 : smart LTF logic - dynamic timeframe selection for improved volume distribution accuracy, Profile Gaps/Voids
//# *
//# * ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ //

indicator('Volume Profile and Indicator by DGT', 'VP ☼☾', overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_bars_back = 5000)

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Inputs
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

display = display.all - display.status_line

vpGR = 'Volume & Sentiment Profile'

vpSH = input.bool(true, 'Volume Profile', group = vpGR, 
     tooltip = 'Displays total trading activity at each price level within the selected range.\n\n' +
         'Row length represents the amount of traded volume at that level.\n\n' +
         'High-volume areas:\n' +
         '• Often indicate consolidation or value areas.\n\n' +
         'Low-volume areas:\n' +
         '• Often indicate supply/demand zones or liquidity gaps.')

vpUC = input.color(color.new(#5d606b, 50), '  Up Volume  ', inline = 'VP', group = vpGR)
vpDC = input.color(color.new(#d1d4dc, 50), 'Down Volume ', inline = 'VP', group = vpGR)

vaUC = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 30), '  Value Area Up', inline = 'VA', group = vpGR)
vaDC = input.color(color.new(#fbc02d, 30), 'Value Area Down', inline = 'VA', group = vpGR)

spSH = input.bool(true, 'Sentiment Profile', group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Displays the dominant trading side at each price level within the selected range.\n\n' +
         'Row length represents the strength of buying or selling activity.\n\n' +
         'Bullish nodes:\n' +
         '• Buying activity exceeds selling activity.\n\n' +
         'Bearish nodes:\n' +
         '• Selling activity exceeds buying activity.')

spUC = input.color(color.new(#26a69a, 30), '  Bullish', inline = 'BB', group = vpGR)
spDC = input.color(color.new(#ef5350, 30), ' Bearish', inline = 'BB', group = vpGR)

sdSH = input.bool(true, 'Supply & Demand Zones', group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Highlights potential supply and demand areas derived from the volume profile structure.\n\n' +
         'Supply zones:\n' +
         '• Areas where selling pressure may emerge.\n\n' +
         'Demand zones:\n' +
         '• Areas where buying pressure may emerge.')

sdTH = input.int(15, '  Supply & Demand Threshold %', minval = 0, maxval = 41, group = vpGR, display = display) / 100
sdSC = input.color(color.new(#ec1313, 80), '  Supply Zones', inline = 'SD', group = vpGR)
sdDC = input.color(color.new(#0094FF, 80), 'Demand Zones', inline = 'SD', group = vpGR)

vgSH = input.bool(true, 'Volume Profile Gaps', inline = 'vnT', group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Detects and highlights Profile Gaps — transition zones within the volume profile where traded activity drops significantly between neighboring nodes.\n\n' +
         'Unlike price gaps, Profile Gaps reveal structural breaks in volume distribution.\n\n' +
         'How to use:\n' +
         '• Mark natural division points between high-volume clusters\n' +
         '• Price often stalls or reacts at these boundaries\n' +
         '• Useful for identifying key structural levels and potential turning zones\n\n' +
         'Sensitivity is controlled by the Node Detection % setting.')

vgC = input.color(color.new(#ff9800, 80), '', inline = 'vnT', group = vpGR)
vgNoN = input.int(7, '  Node Detection %', minval = 0, maxval = 100, display = display, group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Defines how many surrounding nodes must be compared when detecting a volume profile gap.\n\n' +
         'Higher values require more neighboring nodes to confirm a gap.\n\n' +
         'Lower values make the detection more sensitive.') / 100

pcSH = input.string('Developing POC', 'Point of Control', options = ['None', 'Developing POC', 'Last (Line)'], inline = 'POC', group = vpGR, display = display)
pocC = input.color(#f44336, '', inline = 'POC', group = vpGR)
pocW = input.int(2, '', minval = 1, inline = 'POC', group = vpGR, display = display)

vpVA = input.float(68, 'Value Area (%)', minval = 0, maxval = 100, group = vpGR, display = display,
     tooltip = 'Defines the percentage of total traded volume used to calculate the Value Area.\n\n' +
         'The Value Area represents the price range where the majority of trading activity occurred.\n\n' +
         'Typical market convention:\n' +
         '• 68% of total volume.') / 100

vahS = input.bool(true, 'Value Area High (VAH)', inline = 'VAH', group = vpGR)
vahC = input.color(#2962ff, '', inline = 'VAH', group = vpGR)
vahW = input.int(1, '', minval = 1, inline = 'VAH', group = vpGR, display = display)

vlSH = input.bool(true, 'Value Area Low (VAL)', inline = 'VAL', group = vpGR)
valC = input.color(#2962ff, '', inline = 'VAL', group = vpGR)
valW = input.int(1, '', minval = 1, inline = 'VAL', group = vpGR, display = display)

spP1 = 'Bar Polarity'
spP2 = 'Bar Buying/Selling Pressure'
vpPT = input.string(spP1, 'Profile Polarity Method', options = [spP1, spP2], display = display, group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Defines how traded volume is classified as buying or selling activity.\n\n' +
         'Bar Polarity:\n' +
         '• Up volume → close > open\n' +
         '• Down volume → close ≤ open\n\n' +
         'Buying / Selling Pressure:\n' +
         '• Up volume → (close − low) > (high − close)\n' +
         '• Down volume → (close − low) ≤ (high − close)\n\n' +
         'This setting affects both the volume profile and sentiment calculations.')
vsPT = vpPT == spP1

vpLR = input.string('Fixed Range', 'Profile Lookback Range', options = ['Fixed Range', 'Visible Range'], display = display, group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Defines the price range used to build the volume profile.\n\n' +
         'Fixed Range:\n' +
         '• Uses a specified number of historical bars.\n\n' +
         'Visible Range:\n' +
         '• Dynamically adjusts to the currently visible chart area.')
vpRL = vpLR == 'Visible Range'

vpLN = input.int(360, '  Fixed Range Length', minval = 10, maxval = 5000, step = 10, display = display, group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Defines how many historical bars are included when the profile range mode is set to "Fixed Range".\n\n' +
         'Larger values analyze broader market structure.\n' +
         'Smaller values focus on recent market activity.')

vpLN := last_bar_index < vpLN ? last_bar_index : vpLN - 1

vpST = input.bool(true, 'Profile Stats', inline = 'STT', group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Displays a summary table containing key profile statistics.')

ppLS = input.string('Small', '', options = ['Tiny', 'Small', 'Normal'], inline = 'STT', group = vpGR, display = display)
lcDB = input.string('Top Right', '', options = ['Top Right', 'Middle Right', 'Bottom Left'], inline = 'STT', group = vpGR, display = display)

vpLV = input.bool(true, 'Profile Price Levels', inline = 'BBe', group = vpGR,
     tooltip = 'Displays price labels aligned with the volume profile rows.\n\n' +
         'Helps identify precise price levels associated with high or low traded volume.')
rpLS = input.string('Small', '', options = ['Tiny', 'Small', 'Normal'], inline = 'BBe', group = vpGR, display = display)

vpPL = input.string('Right', 'Profile Placement', options = ['Right', 'Left'], group = vpGR, display = display)
vpRT = vpPL == 'Right'
vpNR = input.int(100, 'Profile Number of Rows', minval = 10, maxval = 150, step = 10, group = vpGR, display = display)
vpWD = input.float(31, 'Profile Width (%)', minval = 0, maxval = 250, group = vpGR, display = display) / 100
vpHO = input.int(13, 'Profile Horizontal Offset', maxval = 50, group = vpGR, display = display)

vaBG = input.bool(false, 'Value Area Background  ', inline = 'vBG', group = vpGR)
vBGC = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 89), '', inline = 'vBG', group = vpGR)

vpBG = input.bool(false, 'Profile Range Background ', inline = 'pBG', group = vpGR)
bgC = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 95), '', inline = 'pBG', group = vpGR)

vhGR = 'Volume Histogram'

vhSH = input.bool(true, 'Volume Histogram', group = vhGR,
     tooltip = 'Displays the traded volume for each individual price bar.\n\n' +
         'Higher bars indicate stronger trading activity.\n' +
         'Lower bars indicate reduced market participation.')

vmaS = input.bool(true, 'Volume MA,         Length', inline = 'vol2', group = vhGR)
vmaL = input.int(21, '', minval = 1, inline = 'vol2', group = vhGR, display = display)
vhUC = input.color(color.new(#26a69a, 30), '  Growing', inline = 'vol1', group = vhGR)
vhDC = input.color(color.new(#ef5350, 30), 'Falling', inline = 'vol1', group = vhGR)
vmaC = input.color(color.new(#2962ff, 0), 'Volume MA', inline = 'vol1', group = vhGR)
vhPL = input.string('Top', '  Placement', options = ['Top', 'Bottom'], group = vhGR, display = display)
vhLP = vhPL == 'Top'
vhHT = 11 - input.int(8, '  Height', minval = 1, maxval = 10, group = vhGR, display = display)
vhVO = input.int(1, '  Vertical Offset', minval = 0, maxval = 20, group = vhGR, display = display) / 20

cbGR = 'Volume-Weighted Bar Coloring'

vwcb = input.bool(false, 'Volume-Weighted Bar Coloring', group = cbGR,
     tooltip = 'Colors price bars based on their volume relative to the volume moving average.\n\n' +
         'Strong bars:\n' +
         '• Volume exceeds the upper threshold.\n\n' +
         'Weak bars:\n' +
         '• Volume falls below the lower threshold.\n\n' +
         'Helps highlight unusual buying or selling activity.')

upTH = input.float(1.618, '  Upper Threshold', minval = 1., step = .1, group = cbGR, display = display)
dnTH = input.float(0.618, '  Lower Threshold', minval = .1, step = .1, group = cbGR, display = display)

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// User Defined Types
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

type bar
	float o = open
	float h = high
	float l = low
	float c = close
	float v = volume
	int i = bar_index

type barData
	array<float> bh
	array<float> bl
	array<float> bv
	array<bool> bp
	array<int> bn

type volData
	array<float> vt
	array<float> vb
	array<float> vd

type tVP
	array<box> vp
	array<chart.point> pPC
	polyline dPC
	int pcL
	int laP
	int lbP
	int sI

type tVH
	array<line> vh
	array<chart.point> pMA
	polyline vMA

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Variables
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

var barData bD = barData.new(array.new<float>(na), array.new<float>(na), array.new<float>(na), array.new<bool>(na), array.new<int>(na))

volData vD = volData.new(array.new<float>(vpNR, 0.), array.new<float>(vpNR, 0.), array.new<float>(vpNR, 0.))

var tVP VP = tVP.new(array.new<box>(na), array.new<chart.point>(na), polyline.new(na), na, na, na, na)

var tVH VH = tVH.new(array.new<line>(na), array.new<chart.point>(na), polyline.new(na))

array<bar> ltfBD = array.new<bar>(1, bar.new())

var float pHST = na
var float pLST = na
var string ltf = na

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Functions / Methods
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

f_drawLineX(_x1, _y1, _x2, _y2, _xloc, _extend, _color, _style, _width) =>
    var id = line.new(_x1, _y1, _x2, _y2, _xloc, _extend, _color, _style, _width)
    line.set_xy1(id, _x1, _y1)
    line.set_xy2(id, _x2, _y2)
    line.set_color(id, _color)

f_drawLabelX(_x, _y, _text, _color, _style, _textcolor, _size, _tooltip) =>
    var lb = label.new(_x, _y, _text, xloc.bar_index, yloc.price, _color, _style, _textcolor, _size, text.align_left, _tooltip)
    lb.set_xy(_x, _y)
    lb.set_text(_text)
    lb.set_tooltip(_tooltip)
    lb.set_textcolor(_textcolor)

getData(_ltf) =>
    request.security_lower_tf(syminfo.tickerid, _ltf, bar.new(), ignore_invalid_timeframe = true)

var string[] secTF = array.from('1S','5S','15S','30S')
var string[] minTF = array.from('1','3','5','15','30','60','120','240','1D')

f_gTF(_lookback) =>
    int tfInSec   = timeframe.in_seconds(timeframe.period)
    int totalSec  = tfInSec * _lookback
    int mInSec    = 60

    if timeframe.isseconds
        string result = '1S'
        for tfStr in secTF
            int ltfSec = timeframe.in_seconds(tfStr)
            if totalSec / ltfSec < 5000
                result := tfStr
                break
        result

    else
        int ltfSec = 1 * mInSec

        result = timeframe.period
        for tfStr in minTF
            ltfSec := timeframe.in_seconds(tfStr)
            if totalSec / ltfSec < 5000
                result := tfStr
                break
        result

f_gTS(_t) =>
    switch _t
        'Tiny' => size.tiny
        'Small' => size.small
        'Normal' => size.normal
        => size.auto

f_crossingLevelX(_price, _level) =>
    _level > _price and _level < _price[1] or _level < _price and _level > _price[1]

alarm(_message) =>
    alert(syminfo.ticker + ' ' + _message + ', price ' + str.tostring(close, format.mintick) + ', timeframe ' + timeframe.period, alert.freq_once_per_bar)

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Calculations Volume Profile
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

nzV = nz(volume)
vSMA = ta.sma(nzV, vmaL)

rpS = f_gTS(rpLS)
ppLS := f_gTS(ppLS)

tPOS = lcDB == 'Top Right' ? position.top_right : lcDB == 'Middle Right' ? position.middle_right : position.bottom_left

if time == chart.left_visible_bar_time
    VP.sI := bar_index
    VP.sI

if vpRL
    vpLN := last_bar_index - VP.sI
    vpLN

if bar_index == last_bar_index - vpLN
    VP.sI := bar_index
    pLST := low
    pHST := high
    pHST
else if bar_index > last_bar_index - vpLN
    pLST := math.min(low, pLST)
    pHST := math.max(high, pHST)
    pHST

if barstate.isfirst or vpRL
    ltf := f_gTF(vpLN)

//ltf    := f_gTF(vpLN)
ltfBD  := getData(ltf)

if barstate.ishistory and bar_index >= last_bar_index - vpLN and bar_index < last_bar_index and ltfBD.size() > 0

    if ltfBD.size() > 0 and not na(nz(ltfBD.get(0).v))
        for i = 0 to ltfBD.size() - 1 by 1
            bD.bh.push(ltfBD.get(i).h)
            bD.bl.push(ltfBD.get(i).l)
            bD.bv.push(ltfBD.get(i).v)

            if vsPT
                bD.bp.push(ltfBD.get(i).c > ltfBD.get(i).o)
            else
                bD.bp.push(ltfBD.get(i).c - ltfBD.get(i).l > ltfBD.get(i).h - ltfBD.get(i).c)

        bD.bn.push(ltfBD.size())

pSTP = (pHST - pLST) / vpNR

if barstate.islast and ltfBD.size() > 0

    if VP.vp.size() > 0
        for i = VP.vp.size() - 1 to 0 
            box.delete(VP.vp.shift())

    if bD.bn.size() > vpLN
        qt = bD.bn.shift()
        for i = 0 to qt - 1 by 1
            bD.bh.shift()
            bD.bl.shift()
            bD.bv.shift()
            bD.bp.shift()

    if not na(VP.dPC)
        VP.pPC.clear()
        VP.dPC.delete()

    if ltfBD.size() > 0 and not na(nz(ltfBD.get(0).v))
        for i = 0 to ltfBD.size() - 1 by 1
            bD.bh.push(ltfBD.get(i).h)
            bD.bl.push(ltfBD.get(i).l)
            bD.bv.push(ltfBD.get(i).v)

            if vsPT
                bD.bp.push(ltfBD.get(i).c > ltfBD.get(i).o)
            else
                bD.bp.push(ltfBD.get(i).c - ltfBD.get(i).l > ltfBD.get(i).h - ltfBD.get(i).c)

        bD.bn.push(ltfBD.size())

    bI = vpLN
    bSZ = 0
    aSZ = bD.bv.size()


    for aI = 0 to aSZ - 1 by 1

        lH = bD.bh.get(aI)
        lL = bD.bl.get(aI)
        lV = bD.bv.get(aI)
        lR = math.max(lH - lL, syminfo.mintick)

        int sSI = math.max(math.floor((lL - pLST) / pSTP), 0)
        int eSI = math.min(math.floor((lH - pLST) / pSTP), vpNR - 1)
        //int eSI = math.min(math.ceil((lH - pLST) / pSTP) - 1, vpNR - 1)

        for pLI = sSI to eSI

            float pL = pLST + pLI * pSTP

            vPOR = switch
                lL >= pL and lH > pL + pSTP => (pL + pSTP - lL) / lR
                lH <= pL + pSTP and lL < pL => (lH - pL) / lR
                lL >= pL and lH <= pL + pSTP => 1
                => pSTP / lR

            vD.vt.set(pLI, vD.vt.get(pLI) + lV * vPOR)

            if bD.bp.get(aI)
                vD.vb.set(pLI, vD.vb.get(pLI) + lV * vPOR)

        //i = 0
        //for pLL = pLST to pHST - pSTP by pSTP

        //    lH = bD.bh.get(aI)
        //    lL = bD.bl.get(aI)
        //    lV = bD.bv.get(aI)

        //    if lH >= pLL and lL < pLL + pSTP

        //        vPOR = if lL >= pLL and lH > pLL + pSTP
        //            (pLL + pSTP - lL) / math.max(lH - lL, syminfo.mintick)
        //        else if lH <= pLL + pSTP and lL < pLL
        //            (lH - pLL) / math.max(lH - lL, syminfo.mintick)
        //        else if lL >= pLL and lH <= pLL + pSTP
        //            1
        //        else
        //            pSTP / math.max(lH - lL, syminfo.mintick)

        //        vD.vt.set(i, vD.vt.get(i) + lV * vPOR)

        //        if bD.bp.get(aI)
        //            vD.vb.set(i, vD.vb.get(i) + lV * vPOR)
        //    i := i + 1
        //    i

        if pcSH == 'Developing POC'
            if aI == bD.bn.get(vpLN - bI)
                VP.pPC.push(chart.point.from_index(bar_index[bI], math.avg(high[bI], low[bI])))
                VP.pPC.push(chart.point.from_index(bar_index[bI] + 1, pLST + (vD.vt.indexof(vD.vt.max()) + .5) * pSTP))
                bSZ := bSZ + bD.bn.get(vpLN - bI)
                bI := bI - 1
                bI
            else if aI == bSZ + bD.bn.get(vpLN - bI) and bSZ != 0
                VP.pPC.push(chart.point.from_index(bar_index[bI] + 1, pLST + (vD.vt.indexof(vD.vt.max()) + .5) * pSTP))
                bSZ := bSZ + bD.bn.get(vpLN - bI)
                bI := bI - 1
                bI
            else if bI == 0
                VP.pPC.push(chart.point.from_index(bar_index[bI] + 1, pLST + (vD.vt.indexof(vD.vt.max()) + .5) * pSTP))
                bSZ := bSZ + bD.bn.get(vpLN - bI)
                bSZ

    VP.dPC := polyline.new(VP.pPC, false, false, xloc.bar_index, pocC, color(na), line.style_solid, pocW)

    for i = 0 to vpNR - 1 by 1
        bbp = 2 * vD.vb.get(i) - vD.vt.get(i)
        vD.vd.set(i, vD.vd.get(i) + bbp * (bbp > 0 ? 1 : -1))

    VP.pcL := vD.vt.indexof(vD.vt.max())
    ttV = math.max(vD.vt.sum(), 1e-10) * vpVA
    va = vD.vt.get(VP.pcL)
    VP.laP := VP.pcL
    VP.lbP := VP.pcL

    var int maxIter = vpNR * 2
    int iterCount = 0

    while va < ttV and iterCount < maxIter
        iterCount += 1

        if VP.lbP == 0 and VP.laP == vpNR - 1
            break

        vaP = 0.
        if VP.laP < vpNR - 1
            vaP := vD.vt.get(VP.laP + 1)

        vbP = 0.
        if VP.lbP > 0
            vbP := vD.vt.get(VP.lbP - 1)

        if vaP >= vbP
            va += vaP
            VP.laP += 1
        else
            va += vbP
            VP.lbP -= 1

    vaH = pLST + (VP.laP + 1.) * pSTP
    poc = pLST + (VP.pcL + .5) * pSTP
    vaL = pLST + (VP.lbP + .0) * pSTP
    pLN = vpLN > 360 ? 360 : vpLN

    if vahS
        f_drawLineX(VP.sI, vaH, vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : spSH ? vpHO : 0) + last_bar_index : last_bar_index, vaH, xloc.bar_index, extend.none, vahC, line.style_solid, vahW)

    if pcSH == 'Last (Line)'
        f_drawLineX(VP.sI, poc, last_bar_index, poc, xloc.bar_index, extend.none, pocC, line.style_solid, pocW)

    if vlSH
        f_drawLineX(VP.sI, vaL, vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : spSH ? vpHO : 0) + last_bar_index : last_bar_index, vaL, xloc.bar_index, extend.none, valC, line.style_solid, valW)

    if vaBG
        VP.vp.push(box.new(VP.sI, vaL, last_bar_index, vaH, vBGC, 1, line.style_dotted, bgcolor = vBGC))

    if vpBG
        VP.vp.push(box.new(VP.sI, pLST, last_bar_index, pHST, bgC, 1, line.style_dotted, bgcolor = bgC))

    if vpLV
        f_drawLabelX(vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : spSH ? vpHO : 0) + last_bar_index : last_bar_index, pHST, str.tostring(pHST, format.mintick), color.new(chart.fg_color, 89), vpRT ? not vpSH and not spSH ? label.style_label_left : label.style_label_down : label.style_label_left, chart.fg_color, rpS, 'Profile High')
        f_drawLabelX(vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : spSH ? vpHO : 0) + last_bar_index + (spSH ? int(vD.vd.max() / vD.vt.max() * pLN * vpWD) : 0) : last_bar_index, vaH, str.tostring(vaH, format.mintick), color.new(vahC, 89), label.style_label_left, vahC, rpS, 'Value Area High')
        f_drawLabelX(vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : spSH ? vpHO : 0) + last_bar_index + (spSH ? int(vD.vd.max() / vD.vt.max() * pLN * vpWD) : 0) : last_bar_index, poc, str.tostring(poc, format.mintick), color.new(pocC, 89), label.style_label_left, pocC, rpS, 'Point of Control')
        f_drawLabelX(vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : spSH ? vpHO : 0) + last_bar_index + (spSH ? int(vD.vd.max() / vD.vt.max() * pLN * vpWD) : 0) : last_bar_index, vaL, str.tostring(vaL, format.mintick), color.new(valC, 89), label.style_label_left, valC, rpS, 'Value Area Low')
        f_drawLabelX(vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : spSH ? vpHO : 0) + last_bar_index : last_bar_index, pLST, str.tostring(pLST, format.mintick), color.new(chart.fg_color, 89), vpRT ? not vpSH and not spSH ? label.style_label_left : label.style_label_up : label.style_label_left, chart.fg_color, rpS, 'Profile Low')

    if vpST
        var table change = table.new(tPOS, 2, 10, border_width = 3)
        tC = chart.fg_color
        table.cell(change, 0, 0, 'Profile High', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS, tooltip = 'profile high - ' + str.tostring(pHST, format.mintick) + '\n %' + str.tostring((pHST - pLST) / pLST * 100, '#.##') + ' higher than the profile low (' + str.tostring(pLST, format.mintick) + ')')
        table.cell(change, 1, 0, str.tostring(pHST, format.mintick), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 1, 'Value Area High', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 1, 1, str.tostring(vaH, format.mintick), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 2, 'Point of Control', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 1, 2, str.tostring(poc, format.mintick), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 3, 'Value Area Low', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 1, 3, str.tostring(vaL, format.mintick), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 4, 'Profile Low', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS, tooltip = 'profile low - ' + str.tostring(pLST, format.mintick) + '\n %' + str.tostring((pHST - pLST) / pHST * 100, '#.##') + ' lower than the profile high (' + str.tostring(pHST, format.mintick) + ')')
        table.cell(change, 1, 4, str.tostring(pLST, format.mintick), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 5, 'Total Volume\nin VP Range', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS, tooltip = 'total traded volume in vp range')
        table.cell(change, 1, 5, str.tostring(vD.vt.sum(), format.volume), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 6, 'Avg Volume/Bar', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS, tooltip = 'average traded volume per bar in vp range')
        table.cell(change, 1, 6, str.tostring(vD.vt.sum() / (vpLN + 1), format.volume), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 7, 'Volume MA (' + str.tostring(vmaL) + ')', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS, tooltip = 'volume moving average')
        table.cell(change, 1, 7, str.tostring(vSMA, format.volume), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 8, 'Number of Bars', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS, tooltip = 'number of chart bars : ' + str.tostring(vpLN) + ' + 1 (developing bar)')
        table.cell(change, 1, 8, str.tostring(vpLN + 1), text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)
        table.cell(change, 0, 9, 'Data From', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ppLS, tooltip = 'Smart LTF logic: dynamically selects the optimal lower timeframe to maximize volume distribution accuracy within the lookback range.')
        table.cell(change, 1, 9, ltf + ' TF', text_color = tC, bgcolor = color.new(tC, 80), text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ppLS)

    if  vgSH
        var bool uNth = false, var bool lNth = false
        noN = int(vpNR * vgNoN)

        tVT = vD.vt.copy()

        for index = 1 to noN
            tVT.unshift(vD.vt.max())
            tVT.push(vD.vt.max())
            
        for vn = 0 to vpNR - 1 + 2 * noN 

            if vgSH and vn >= 2 * noN 

                for cVN = vn - 2 * noN to vn - noN - 1
                    if tVT.get(vn - noN) >= tVT.get(cVN)
                        uNth := false
                        break
                    else
                        uNth := true

                for cVN = vn - noN + 1 to vn
                    if tVT.get(vn - noN) >= tVT.get(cVN)
                        lNth := false
                        break
                    else
                        lNth := true

                if uNth and lNth 

                    VP.vp.push(box.new(bar_index[vpLN], pLST + (vn - 2 * noN + .1) * pSTP, vpRT ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) + last_bar_index : bar_index, pLST + (vn - 2 * noN + .9) * pSTP, 
                                          color(na), bgcolor = vgC, xloc = xloc.bar_index))

    for i = 0 to vpNR - 1 by 1

        maxVol = math.max(vD.vt.max(), 1e-10)

        if vpSH
            sBI = vpRT ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) + int(last_bar_index - vD.vb.get(i) / maxVol * pLN * vpWD) : VP.sI
            eBI = vpRT ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) + last_bar_index : int(sBI + vD.vb.get(i) / maxVol * pLN * vpWD)
            VP.vp.push(box.new(sBI, pLST + (i + .1) * pSTP, eBI, pLST + (i + .9) * pSTP, color(na), bgcolor = i >= VP.lbP and i <= VP.laP ? vaUC : vpUC))

            sBI := vpRT ? sBI : eBI
            eBI := vpRT ? sBI - int((vD.vt.get(i) - vD.vb.get(i)) / maxVol * pLN * vpWD) : sBI + int((vD.vt.get(i) - vD.vb.get(i)) / maxVol * pLN * vpWD)
            VP.vp.push(box.new(sBI, pLST + (i + .1) * pSTP, eBI, pLST + (i + .9) * pSTP, color(na), bgcolor = i >= VP.lbP and i <= VP.laP ? vaDC : vpDC))

        if spSH
            sBI = vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : vpHO) + int(last_bar_index + vD.vd.get(i) / maxVol * pLN * vpWD) : VP.sI
            eBI = vpRT ? (vpSH ? int(pLN * vpWD + vpHO) : vpHO) + last_bar_index : vpRL ? int(sBI + vD.vd.get(i) / maxVol * pLN * vpWD) : int(sBI - vD.vd.get(i) / maxVol * pLN * vpWD)

            bbp = 2 * vD.vb.get(i) - vD.vt.get(i)
            VP.vp.push(box.new(sBI + 1, pLST + (i + .1) * pSTP, eBI + 1, pLST + (i + .9) * pSTP, color(na), bgcolor = bbp > 0 ? spUC : spDC))

        if sdSH and vD.vt.get(i) / maxVol < sdTH
            sdC = pLST + (i + 0.50) * pSTP > pLST + (VP.pcL + .5) * pSTP ? sdSC : sdDC
            VP.vp.push(box.new(bar_index[vpLN], pLST + (i + 1.) * pSTP, bar_index, pLST + (i + .0) * pSTP, color(na), bgcolor = sdC))


//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Calculations Volume Histogram
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

pHSTv = ta.highest(high, vpLN < 497 ? vpLN : 496)
pLSTv = ta.lowest(low, vpLN < 497 ? vpLN : 496)
vHST = ta.highest(nzV, vpLN < 497 ? vpLN : 496)
vMAR = nzV / vSMA

if barstate.islast and not na(nzV) and vhSH and vSMA > 0

    pCHR = (pHSTv - pLSTv) / pHSTv

    if VH.vh.size() > 0
        for i = 0 to VH.vh.size() - 1 by 1
            line.delete(VH.vh.shift())

    VH.pMA.clear()
    VH.vMA.delete()

    for bI = 0 to vpLN by 1

        if VH.vh.size() < 500
            VH.vh.push(line.new(bar_index[bI], vhLP ? pHST + pHSTv * pCHR * vhVO : pLST - pLSTv * pCHR * vhVO, bar_index[bI], (vhLP ? pHST + pHSTv * pCHR * vhVO : pLST - pLSTv * pCHR * vhVO) * (1 + (vhLP ? 1 : -1) * nzV[bI] / vHST * pCHR / vhHT), xloc.bar_index, extend.none, close[bI] > open[bI] ? vhUC : vhDC, line.style_solid, 2))

            if vmaS and not na(vSMA[bI])
                VH.pMA.push(chart.point.from_index(bar_index[bI], (vhLP ? pHST + pHSTv * pCHR * vhVO : pLST - pLSTv * pCHR * vhVO) * (1 + (vhLP ? 1 : -1) * nzV[bI] / vHST * pCHR / vhHT / vMAR[bI])))

    VH.vMA := polyline.new(VH.pMA, false, false, xloc.bar_index, vmaC, color(na), line.style_solid, 1)
    VH.vMA

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Calculations Volume Weighted Colored Bars
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

barcolor(vwcb and not na(nzV) ? nzV > vSMA * upTH ? open < close ? #006400 : #910000 : nzV < vSMA * dnTH ? open < close ? #7FFFD4 : #FF9800 : na : na, title = 'Volume Weighted Colored Bars', editable = false)

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Alerts
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

if f_crossingLevelX(close[1], pLST + (VP.pcL + .50) * pSTP) and pcSH != 'None'
    alarm('price action ' + (close[1] > pLST + (VP.pcL + .50) * pSTP ? 'crossed above ' : 'crossed below ') + 'the point of control line')

if f_crossingLevelX(close[1], pLST + (VP.laP + 1.00) * pSTP) and vahS
    alarm('price action ' + (close[1] > pLST + (VP.laP + 1.00) * pSTP ? 'crossed above ' : 'crossed below ') + 'the value area high line')

if f_crossingLevelX(close[1], pLST + (VP.lbP + 0.00) * pSTP) and vlSH
    alarm('price action ' + (close[1] > pLST + (VP.lbP + 0.00) * pSTP ? 'crossed above ' : 'crossed below ') + 'the value area low line')

if nzV > vSMA * upTH and (vwcb or vhSH)
    alarm('high volume detected')

if nzV > vSMA * 4.669 and (vwcb or vhSH)
    alarm('watch out volume spike detected, may be a sign of exhaustion')

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{

var table logo = table.new(position.bottom_right, 1, 1)
if barstate.islast
    table.cell(logo, 0, 0, '☼☾  ', text_size = size.normal, text_color = color.teal, tooltip = 'SoleMare Analytics')

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}

items.source:
//
// @author LazyBear 
// List of all my indicators: https://www.tradingview.com/v/4IneGo8h/
//
study("Weis Wave Volume [LazyBear]", shorttitle="WWV_LB")
trendDetectionLength=input(2)
showDistributionBelowZero=input(false, type=bool)
mov = close>close[1] ? 1 : close<close[1] ? -1 : 0
trend= (mov != 0) and (mov != mov[1]) ? mov : nz(trend[1])
isTrending = rising(close, trendDetectionLength) or falling(close, trendDetectionLength) //abs(close-close[1]) >= dif
wave=(trend != nz(wave[1])) and isTrending ? trend : nz(wave[1])
vol=wave==wave[1] ? (nz(vol[1])+volume) : volume
up=wave == 1 ? vol : 0
dn=showDistributionBelowZero ? (wave == 1 ? 0 : wave == -1 ? -vol : vol) : (wave == 1 ? 0 : vol)
plot(up, style=histogram, color=green, linewidth=3)
plot(dn, style=histogram, color=red, linewidth=3)

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//  Copyright by HPotter v1.0 23/05/2014
//  Ichimoku
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
middleDonchian(Length) =>
    lower = lowest(Length)
    upper = highest(Length)
    avg(upper, lower)

study(title="Ichimoku2c", shorttitle="Ichimoku2c", overlay = true)
conversionPeriods = input(9, minval=1),
basePeriods = input(26, minval=1)
laggingSpan2Periods = input(52, minval=1),
displacement = input(26, minval=1)
Tenkan = middleDonchian(conversionPeriods)
Kijun =  middleDonchian(basePeriods)
xChikou = close
SenkouA = middleDonchian(laggingSpan2Periods)
SenkouB = (Tenkan[basePeriods] + Kijun[basePeriods]) / 2
plot(Tenkan, color=red, title="Tenkan")
plot(Kijun, color=blue, title="Kijun")
plot(xChikou, color= teal , title="Chikou", offset = -displacement)
A = plot(SenkouA[displacement], color=purple, title="SenkouA")
B = plot(SenkouB, color=green, title="SenkouB")
fill(A, B, color=green)

//@version=6
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SELF-AWARE TREND SYSTEM [WillyAlgoTrader]
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Author:  Willy | WillyAlgoTrader
// Version: 1.13.1
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 1. INDICATOR DECLARATION
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
indicator(
     title              = "Self-Aware Trend System [WillyAlgoTrader]",
     shorttitle         = "SATS",
     overlay            = true,
     max_lines_count    = 500,
     max_labels_count   = 500,
     max_bars_back      = 5000)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 2. CONSTANTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
GRP_MAIN    = "⚙️ Main Settings"
GRP_ADAPT   = "🧠 Adaptive Engine"
GRP_TQI     = "📐 Trend Quality Engine"
GRP_FILTER  = "🔍 Score Components (not entry filters)"
GRP_RISK    = "🎯 Risk Management"
GRP_DYN_TP  = "🎯 Dynamic TP Settings"
GRP_LEARN   = "🤖 Self-Learning"
GRP_VISUAL  = "🎨 Visual"
GRP_DASH    = "📊 Dashboard"
GRP_ALERT   = "🔔 Alerts"
GRP_COLORS  = "🎨 Colors"

INDICATOR_VERSION = "v1.13.1"
WARMUP_FLOOR      = 50
MAX_HISTORY_SIGS  = 100
HIT_COLOR_HEX     = #40E0D0
MAX_SCORE_REF     = 100      // 4 factors × 17 + structure 16 + break 16

ER_LOW_THRESH    = 0.25
ER_HIGH_THRESH   = 0.50
VOL_LOW_THRESH   = 0.7
VOL_HIGH_THRESH  = 1.3

EWMA_ALPHA       = 0.2
MULT_SMOOTH_ALPHA = 0.15

// Band geometry — shape of the TQI multiplier and asymmetry limits
TQI_MULT_FLOOR   = 0.6   // band width at perfect quality (TQI = 1)
TQI_MULT_RANGE   = 0.8   // added width at worst quality (TQI = 0)
ASYM_TIGHTEN_MAX = 0.3   // max tightening of the active side at TQI = 1
ASYM_WIDEN_MAX   = 0.4   // max widening of the passive side at TQI = 1

// Grade thresholds (score-based, 0..100 scale)
GRADE_SCORE_APLUS = 80
GRADE_SCORE_A     = 60
GRADE_SCORE_B     = 40

// Grade thresholds (TQI-based, 0..1 scale)
GRADE_TQI_APLUS = 0.70
GRADE_TQI_A     = 0.50
GRADE_TQI_B     = 0.35

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 3. INPUTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
presetInput      = input.string("Auto", "Preset", options = ["Auto", "Custom", "Scalping", "Default", "Swing", "Crypto 24/7"], group = GRP_MAIN, tooltip = "Quick presets that override key parameters.")
atrLenInput      = input.int(13, "ATR Length", minval = 5, maxval = 100, group = GRP_MAIN)
baseMultInput    = input.float(2.0, "Base Band Width (xATR)", minval = 0.5, maxval = 5.0, step = 0.1, group = GRP_MAIN)
sourceInput      = input.source(close, "Source", group = GRP_MAIN)

// ── Adaptive Engine (legacy ER adaptation) ────────────────
useAdaptiveInput    = input.bool(true, "Enable Vol-Adaptive Bands (legacy ER)", group = GRP_ADAPT, tooltip = "Legacy linear ER modulation. Kept for backwards compat — TQI Engine below is recommended.")
erLengthInput       = input.int(20, "Efficiency Window", minval = 5, maxval = 100, group = GRP_ADAPT)
adaptStrengthInput  = input.float(0.5, "Adaptation Strength", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = GRP_ADAPT)
atrBaselineLenInput = input.int(100, "ATR Baseline Length", minval = 20, maxval = 500, group = GRP_ADAPT)

// ── Trend Quality Engine ──────────────────────────────────
useTqiInput          = input.bool(true, "Enable Trend Quality Engine", group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "Master switch. Computes continuous Trend Quality Index (TQI 0..1) each bar from 4 factors. Modulates band width non-linearly.")
qualityStrengthInput = input.float(0.4, "Quality Influence", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "How aggressively TQI compresses/expands bands. 0 = no effect, 1 = maximum.")
qualityCurveInput    = input.float(1.5, "Quality Curve Power", minval = 1.0, maxval = 3.0, step = 0.1, group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "Non-linearity. 1.0 = linear, >1 = bands expand slowly for mild quality drops, rapidly for severe ones.")
multSmoothInput      = input.bool(true, "Smooth Adaptive Multipliers", group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "EMA-smooths band multipliers before applying ratchet logic. Reduces abrupt multiplier changes; the band ratchet still applies.")

useAsymBandsInput    = input.bool(true, "Asymmetric Bands", group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "Active side (in direction of trend) tightens, passive side widens. Creates ratchet-with-leverage effect in strong trends.")
asymStrengthInput    = input.float(0.5, "Asymmetry Strength", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI)

useEffAtrInput       = input.bool(true, "Efficiency-Weighted ATR", group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "Scale ATR by (0.5 + 0.5*ER). Clean trending volatility counts full; noisy volatility is halved.")

useCharFlipInput     = input.bool(true, "Character-Flip Detection", group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "Allow SuperTrend to flip on quality collapse, not just price break. TQI must collapse from above High threshold (anywhere within the lookback window) to below Low threshold, with price already moving against the trend.")
charFlipMinAgeInput  = input.int(5, "Char-Flip: Min Trend Age / Window", minval = 1, maxval = 50, group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "Minimum bars current trend must hold before char-flip can fire. Also defines the TQI collapse lookback window (min 3 bars).")
charFlipHighInput    = input.float(0.55, "Char-Flip: High TQI", minval = 0.3, maxval = 0.9, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI)
charFlipLowInput     = input.float(0.25, "Char-Flip: Low TQI", minval = 0.0, maxval = 0.5, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI)

// TQI factor weights
tqiWeightErInput     = input.float(0.35, "Weight: Efficiency", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI)
tqiWeightVolInput    = input.float(0.20, "Weight: Selected Vol Factor", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI)
tqiWeightStructInput = input.float(0.25, "Weight: Structure", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI)
tqiWeightMomInput    = input.float(0.20, "Weight: Momentum Persist", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = GRP_TQI)
tqiStructLenInput    = input.int(20, "Structure Window", minval = 5, maxval = 100, group = GRP_TQI, tooltip = "Lookback for structural price-position calculation.")
tqiMomLenInput       = input.int(10, "Momentum Persist Window", minval = 3, maxval = 50, group = GRP_TQI)

// ── Signal Filters (display only, kept for dashboard) ─────

safeDiv(float num, float den, float fallback = 0.0) =>
    den != 0 and not na(num) and not na(den) ? num / den : fallback

clamp(float v, float lo, float hi) =>
    math.max(lo, math.min(hi, v))

clampInt(int v, int lo, int hi) =>
    math.max(lo, math.min(hi, v))

calcEfficiencyRatio(float src, int len) =>
    float change     = math.abs(src - src[len])
    float volatility = math.sum(math.abs(src - src[1]), len)
    safeDiv(change, volatility, 0.0)

calcVolumeZ(int len) =>
    float vMean = ta.sma(volume, len)
    float vStd  = ta.stdev(volume, len)
    safeDiv(volume - vMean, vStd, 0.0)

mapClamp(float v, float inLo, float inHi, float outLo, float outHi) =>
    float t = clamp(safeDiv(v - inLo, inHi - inLo, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)
    outLo + t * (outHi - outLo)

mapClampInv(float v, float inLo, float inHi, float outHigh, float outLow) =>
    float t = clamp(safeDiv(v - inLo, inHi - inLo, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)
    outHigh - t * (outHigh - outLow)

getDashPos(string s) =>
    switch s
        "Top Left"     => position.top_left
        "Top Right"    => position.top_right
        "Bottom Left"  => position.bottom_left
        "Bottom Right" => position.bottom_right
        =>                position.middle_right

erBin(float er) =>
    er < ER_LOW_THRESH ? 0 : (er < ER_HIGH_THRESH ? 1 : 2)

volBin(float vRatio) =>
    vRatio < VOL_LOW_THRESH ? 0 : (vRatio < VOL_HIGH_THRESH ? 1 : 2)

cellIdx(int eb, int vb) =>
    eb * 3 + vb

// All price-return accounting uses the initial risk, even after partial exits.
roundDownTick(float value) =>
    math.floor(value / syminfo.mintick + 1e-9) * syminfo.mintick

roundUpTick(float value) =>
    math.ceil(value / syminfo.mintick - 1e-9) * syminfo.mintick

signedR(float value) =>
    na(value) ? "—" : (value > 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(value, "0.00")

jsonNumber(float value) =>
    na(value) ? "null" : str.tostring(value, "0.################")

jsonString(string value) =>
    string escaped = str.replace_all(value, "\\", "\\\\")
    escaped := str.replace_all(escaped, '"', '\\"')
    escaped := str.replace_all(escaped, "\n", "\\n")
    escaped := str.replace_all(escaped, "\r", "\\r")
    escaped := str.replace_all(escaped, "\t", "\\t")
    '"' + escaped + '"'

// 5.3  DYNAMIC TP CALCULATOR
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
calcDynTpScale(float tqiVal, float volRatioVal, float tqiWeight, float volWeight, float minScale, float maxScale) =>
    float tqiComp = clamp(tqiVal, 0.0, 1.0)
    float volComp = clamp(mapClamp(volRatioVal, 0.5, 2.0, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)
    float wSum    = tqiWeight + volWeight
    float wDenom  = wSum > 0 ? wSum : 1.0
    float rawScale = (tqiComp * tqiWeight + volComp * volWeight) / wDenom
    float finalScale = minScale + rawScale * (maxScale - minScale)
    wSum > 0 ? finalScale : 1.0

var array<float> signalRBuffer = array.new<float>()
var array<int>   gridCount = array.new<int>(9, 0)
var array<float> gridEwmR  = array.new<float>(9, 0.0)

updateGridCell(int idx, float r) =>
    if idx >= 0 and idx < 9
        int   c       = array.get(gridCount, idx) + 1
        float prevEwm = array.get(gridEwmR, idx)
        float newEwm  = c == 1 ? r : prevEwm * (1.0 - EWMA_ALPHA) + r * EWMA_ALPHA
        array.set(gridCount, idx, c)
        array.set(gridEwmR,  idx, newEwm)

calcRollingStats(int window) =>
    int n = array.size(signalRBuffer)
    if n == 0
        [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    else
        int startIdx = math.max(0, n - window)
        float sumR = 0.0
        int   wins = 0
        float runningR = 0.0
        float minRun   = 0.0
        float peakRun  = 0.0
        for i = startIdx to n - 1
            float r = array.get(signalRBuffer, i)
            sumR += r
            if r > 1e-8
                wins += 1
            runningR += r
            peakRun := math.max(peakRun, runningR)
            minRun := math.min(minRun, runningR - peakRun)
        int   cnt   = n - startIdx
        float winRt = cnt > 0 ? float(wins) / float(cnt) : 0.0
        float avgR  = cnt > 0 ? sumR / float(cnt) : 0.0
        [winRt, avgR, minRun]

getRegimeEdge(int idx) =>
    int   c   = array.get(gridCount, idx)
    float ewm = array.get(gridEwmR,  idx)
    [c, ewm]

// ── LearnState: all learning statistics in a single object,
//    so record() can be called from ANY exit point
type LearnState
    int   allTimeCount     = 0
    float allTimePeak      = 0.0
    float allTimeTrough    = 0.0
    float allTimeCumR      = 0.0
    int   curWinStreak     = 0
    int   curLossStreak    = 0
    int   maxWinStreak     = 0
    int   maxLossStreak    = 0
    int   signalsSinceCalib = 0
    int   breakEvenCount = 0
    int   epoch = 0
    float epochSum = 0.0
    string calibStatus = "Collecting epoch"
    float effQ             = na   // effective Quality Influence (auto-calib)
    int   lastShiftDir     = 0    // -1 / 0 / +1 — direction of the last effQ shift
    float avgRAtLastShift  = na   // avgR at the moment of the last shift (for hill-climbing)

method record(LearnState this, float r, int cIdx, int entryEpoch) =>
    // 1) rolling buffer
    array.push(signalRBuffer, r)
    while array.size(signalRBuffer) > MAX_HISTORY_SIGS
        array.shift(signalRBuffer)
    // 2) all-time stats
    this.allTimeCount += 1
    this.allTimeCumR  += r
    if this.allTimeCumR > this.allTimePeak
        this.allTimePeak := this.allTimeCumR
    float curDD = this.allTimeCumR - this.allTimePeak
    if curDD < this.allTimeTrough
        this.allTimeTrough := curDD
    // 3) streaks
    if r > 1e-8
        this.curWinStreak  += 1
        this.curLossStreak := 0
        if this.curWinStreak > this.maxWinStreak
            this.maxWinStreak := this.curWinStreak
    else if r < -1e-8
        this.curLossStreak += 1
        this.curWinStreak  := 0
        if this.curLossStreak > this.maxLossStreak
            this.maxLossStreak := this.curLossStreak
    else
        this.breakEvenCount += 1
        this.curWinStreak := 0
        this.curLossStreak := 0
    // 4) regime grid
    updateGridCell(cIdx, r)
    // Non-overlapping epochs contain only trades entered under that Q.
    if useAutoCalibInput and useTqiInput and entryEpoch == this.epoch
        this.signalsSinceCalib += 1
        this.epochSum += r
        int required = math.max(calibWindowInput, calibCooldownInput)
        if this.signalsSinceCalib >= required
            float postAvgR = this.epochSum / this.signalsSinceCalib
            if postAvgR < calibBadRInput
                int dir = this.lastShiftDir == 0 ? 1 : (na(this.avgRAtLastShift) or postAvgR >= this.avgRAtLastShift ? this.lastShiftDir : -this.lastShiftDir)
                if (dir > 0 and this.effQ >= calibMaxQInput) or (dir < 0 and this.effQ <= calibMinQInput)
                    dir := -dir
                float nextQ = clamp(this.effQ + dir * calibStepQInput, calibMinQInput, calibMaxQInput)
                this.calibStatus := str.tostring(this.effQ, "0.00") + " -> " + str.tostring(nextQ, "0.00") + " (poor epoch)"
                this.effQ := nextQ
                this.lastShiftDir := dir
            else
                this.calibStatus := postAvgR > calibGoodRInput ? "Good epoch: hold Q" : "Neutral epoch: hold Q"
                if postAvgR > calibGoodRInput
                    this.lastShiftDir := 0
            this.avgRAtLastShift := postAvgR
            this.signalsSinceCalib := 0
            this.epochSum := 0.0
            this.epoch += 1


var LearnState learn = LearnState.new()

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6. BASE CALCULATIONS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Preserve na during initialization: SMA must see real ATR observations.
int warmupBars = math.max(WARMUP_FLOOR, math.max(effectiveAtrLen + atrBaselineLenInput - 2, math.max(effectiveRsiLen + rsiLookbackInput - 1, math.max(effectiveErLen, math.max(tqiMomLenInput, tqiStructLenInput)))))
float rawAtr = ta.atr(effectiveAtrLen)
float atrBaseline = ta.sma(rawAtr, atrBaselineLenInput)
float rsiVal = ta.rsi(close, effectiveRsiLen)
float volRatio = safeDiv(rawAtr, atrBaseline, 1.0)
bool isWarmedUp = bar_index >= warmupBars and not na(atrBaseline) and rawAtr > 0 and atrBaseline > 0 and not na(sourceInput) and not na(sourceInput[effectiveErLen]) and (not useRsiInput or not na(rsiVal[rsiLookbackInput - 1]))
float validSourcePairs = math.sum(not na(sourceInput) and not na(sourceInput[1]) ? 1.0 : 0.0, effectiveErLen)
isWarmedUp := isWarmedUp and validSourcePairs == effectiveErLen


// ER is computed on the same series as the bands (Source) — unified logic
float erValue     = calcEfficiencyRatio(sourceInput, effectiveErLen)

float atrValue = useEffAtrInput ? rawAtr * (0.5 + 0.5 * erValue) : rawAtr

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6.1  TREND QUALITY INDEX (continuous, every bar)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
float tqiEr = clamp(erValue, 0.0, 1.0)

// Volume validity is recomputed for the complete current window.
float volumeValidCount = math.sum(not na(volume) ? 1.0 : 0.0, volLenInput)
float volumeStd = ta.stdev(volume, volLenInput)
float volZRaw = calcVolumeZ(volLenInput)
bool hasVolume = volumeValidCount == volLenInput and volumeStd > 0
bool tqiVolAvailable = tqiVolModeInput == "ATR regime" or hasVolume
float tqiVol = tqiVolModeInput == "ATR regime" ? mapClamp(volRatio, 0.6, 1.8, 0.0, 1.0) : (hasVolume ? mapClamp(volZRaw, -1.0, 2.0, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0)


float structHi = ta.highest(high, tqiStructLenInput)
float structLo = ta.lowest(low,  tqiStructLenInput)
float structRange = structHi - structLo
float pricePos = safeDiv(close - structLo, structRange, 0.5)
float tqiStruct = clamp(math.abs(pricePos - 0.5) * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0)

// Momentum Persistence without a per-bar loop: the number of bars
// aligned with the window direction = rolling sum of up/down moves.
// Mathematically equivalent to the old loop, but O(1) per bar.
float windowChange = close - close[tqiMomLenInput]
float upMoves   = nz(math.sum(close > close[1] ? 1.0 : 0.0, tqiMomLenInput), 0.0)
float downMoves = nz(math.sum(close < close[1] ? 1.0 : 0.0, tqiMomLenInput), 0.0)
float tqiMom = windowChange > 0 ? upMoves / tqiMomLenInput : windowChange < 0 ? downMoves / tqiMomLenInput : 0.0

float availableVolWeight = tqiVolAvailable ? tqiWeightVolInput : 0.0
float tqiWeightSum = tqiWeightErInput + availableVolWeight + tqiWeightStructInput + tqiWeightMomInput
bool tqiReady = not useTqiInput or tqiWeightSum > 0
isWarmedUp := isWarmedUp and tqiReady
float tqiWeightDenom = tqiWeightSum > 0 ? tqiWeightSum : 1.0
float tqiRaw = useTqiInput ? (tqiEr * tqiWeightErInput + tqiVol * availableVolWeight + tqiStruct * tqiWeightStructInput + tqiMom * tqiWeightMomInput) / tqiWeightDenom : 0.5
float tqi = clamp(tqiRaw, 0.0, 1.0)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6.2  ADAPTIVE MULTIPLIERS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
float legacyAdaptFactor = useAdaptiveInput ? (1.0 + adaptStrengthInput * (0.5 - erValue)) : 1.0

if barstate.isfirst
    learn.effQ := useAutoCalibInput ? clamp(qualityStrengthInput, calibMinQInput, calibMaxQInput) : qualityStrengthInput
if not useAutoCalibInput
    learn.effQ := qualityStrengthInput
float effectiveQualityStrength = learn.effQ

float qualityDeviation = useTqiInput ? math.pow(1.0 - tqi, qualityCurveInput) : 0.5
float tqiMult = 1.0 - effectiveQualityStrength + effectiveQualityStrength * (TQI_MULT_FLOOR + TQI_MULT_RANGE * qualityDeviation)

float symMult = effectiveBaseMult * legacyAdaptFactor * tqiMult

float activeMultRaw  = symMult
float passiveMultRaw = symMult
if useTqiInput and useAsymBandsInput
    float asymTighten = 1.0 - asymStrengthInput * tqi * ASYM_TIGHTEN_MAX
    float asymWiden   = 1.0 + asymStrengthInput * tqi * ASYM_WIDEN_MAX
    activeMultRaw  := symMult * asymTighten
    passiveMultRaw := symMult * asymWiden

var float activeMultSm  = na
var float passiveMultSm = na
activeMultSm  := na(activeMultSm[1])  ? activeMultRaw  : (multSmoothInput ? activeMultSm[1]  * (1.0 - MULT_SMOOTH_ALPHA) + activeMultRaw  * MULT_SMOOTH_ALPHA : activeMultRaw)
passiveMultSm := na(passiveMultSm[1]) ? passiveMultRaw : (multSmoothInput ? passiveMultSm[1] * (1.0 - MULT_SMOOTH_ALPHA) + passiveMultRaw * MULT_SMOOTH_ALPHA : passiveMultRaw)

float activeMult  = activeMultSm
float passiveMult = passiveMultSm

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6.3  ADAPTIVE SUPERTREND (asymmetric-aware)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var float lowerBand = na
var float upperBand = na
var int   stTrend   = 1

int prevTrend = na(stTrend[1]) ? 1 : stTrend[1]

float lowerMult = prevTrend == 1 ? activeMult  : passiveMult
float upperMult = prevTrend == 1 ? passiveMult : activeMult

float lowerBandRaw = sourceInput - lowerMult * atrValue
float upperBandRaw = sourceInput + upperMult * atrValue

lowerBand := na(lowerBand[1]) ? lowerBandRaw : (close[1] > lowerBand[1] ? math.max(lowerBandRaw, lowerBand[1]) : lowerBandRaw)
upperBand := na(upperBand[1]) ? upperBandRaw : (close[1] < upperBand[1] ? math.min(upperBandRaw, upperBand[1]) : upperBandRaw)

bool priceFlipUp   = prevTrend == -1 and close > upperBand[1]
bool priceFlipDown = prevTrend ==  1 and close < lowerBand[1]

var int trendStartBar = 0
int trendAge = bar_index - trendStartBar

int   charFlipWindow = math.max(charFlipMinAgeInput, 3)
float tqiWindowHigh  = ta.highest(tqi, charFlipWindow)

bool charFlipCondBase = useCharFlipInput and useTqiInput and trendAge >= charFlipMinAgeInput and tqiWindowHigh > charFlipHighInput and tqi < charFlipLowInput
bool charFlipDown = charFlipCondBase and prevTrend ==  1 and close < close[charFlipWindow]
bool charFlipUp   = charFlipCondBase and prevTrend == -1 and close > close[charFlipWindow]

bool finalFlipUp   = priceFlipUp   or charFlipUp
bool finalFlipDown = priceFlipDown or charFlipDown

stTrend := na(stTrend[1]) ? 1 : (finalFlipUp ? 1 : (finalFlipDown ? -1 : prevTrend))

if stTrend != prevTrend
    trendStartBar := bar_index

float stLine = stTrend == 1 ? lowerBand : upperBand

bool flipUp   = stTrend ==  1 and stTrend[1] == -1
bool flipDown = stTrend == -1 and stTrend[1] ==  1

// Character-flip event tracking — true only when flip happened via TQI collapse,
// not via price break. Used for alerts.
bool charFlipFiredUp   = charFlipUp   and not priceFlipUp   and flipUp
bool charFlipFiredDown = charFlipDown and not priceFlipDown and flipDown
bool charFlipFired     = charFlipFiredUp or charFlipFiredDown

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6.35  DYNAMIC TP R-MULTIPLES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
bool useDynTp = tpModeInput == "Dynamic"

float dynScale = useDynTp ? calcDynTpScale(tqi, volRatio, dynTpTqiWeightInput, dynTpVolWeightInput, dynTpMinScaleInput, dynTpMaxScaleInput) : 1.0

float tp1Floor = math.min(dynTpFloorR1Input, dynTpCeilR3Input)
float tp2Floor = math.min(dynTpFloorR1Input * (fixedTp2R / math.max(fixedTp1R, 0.01)), dynTpCeilR3Input)
float tp3Floor = math.min(dynTpFloorR1Input * (fixedTp3R / math.max(fixedTp1R, 0.01)), dynTpCeilR3Input)
float effTp1R = useDynTp ? clamp(fixedTp1R * dynScale, tp1Floor, dynTpCeilR3Input) : fixedTp1R
float effTp2R = useDynTp ? clamp(fixedTp2R * dynScale, tp2Floor, dynTpCeilR3Input) : fixedTp2R
float effTp3R = useDynTp ? clamp(fixedTp3R * dynScale, tp3Floor, dynTpCeilR3Input) : fixedTp3R

// Sorting after the clamps — guarantees live1 ≤ live2 ≤ live3
float liveTp1R = math.min(effTp1R, math.min(effTp2R, effTp3R))
float liveTp3R = math.max(effTp1R, math.max(effTp2R, effTp3R))
float liveTp2R = effTp1R + effTp2R + effTp3R - liveTp1R - liveTp3R

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6.4  LEGACY DISPLAY DATA + SIGNAL SCORE
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
float volZ      = hasVolume ? volZRaw : 0.0

float rsiLowestG  = ta.lowest(rsiVal,  rsiLookbackInput)
float rsiHighestG = ta.highest(rsiVal, rsiLookbackInput)

float pivotHigh = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLenInput, pivotLenInput)
float pivotLow  = ta.pivotlow(low,   pivotLenInput, pivotLenInput)

var float lastPivotHigh = na
var float lastPivotLow  = na
var int lastPivotHighBar = na
var int lastPivotLowBar = na

if not na(pivotHigh)
    lastPivotHigh := pivotHigh
    lastPivotHighBar := bar_index - pivotLenInput
if not na(pivotLow)
    lastPivotLow := pivotLow
    lastPivotLowBar := bar_index - pivotLenInput

bool validLowPivot = not na(lastPivotLow) and bar_index - lastPivotLowBar <= pivotMaxAgeInput and lastPivotLow < close
bool validHighPivot = not na(lastPivotHigh) and bar_index - lastPivotHighBar <= pivotMaxAgeInput and lastPivotHigh > close

calcScoreBreakdown(bool isBuy, float rsiLo, float rsiHi) =>
    float dirMove  = isBuy ? close - close[3] : close[3] - close
    float momScore = mapClamp(safeDiv(dirMove, atrValue, 0.0), 0.3, 2.0, 0.0, 17.0)
    float erScore  = mapClamp(erValue, 0.15, 0.7, 0.0, 17.0)
    float vScore   = useVolInput and hasVolume ? mapClamp(volZ, 0.0, 3.0, 0.0, 17.0) : 0.0
    float rsiDepth = isBuy ? math.max(0.0, rsiOSInput - rsiLo) : math.max(0.0, rsiHi - rsiOBInput)
    float rsiScore = useRsiInput ? mapClamp(rsiDepth, 0.0, 15.0, 0.0, 17.0) : 0.0
    float pivDist     = isBuy and not na(lastPivotLow) ? math.abs(close - lastPivotLow) : (not isBuy and not na(lastPivotHigh) ? math.abs(lastPivotHigh - close) : 0.0)
    bool pivotAvailable = isBuy ? validLowPivot : validHighPivot
    float structScore = useStructureInput and pivotAvailable ? mapClampInv(safeDiv(pivDist, atrValue, 0.0), 0.0, 1.5, 16.0, 6.0) : 0.0
    float breakDepth = isBuy ? math.max(0.0, close - upperBand[1]) : math.max(0.0, lowerBand[1] - close)
    float breakScore = mapClamp(safeDiv(breakDepth, atrValue, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 16.0)
    [momScore, erScore, vScore, rsiScore, structScore, breakScore]

// Breakdown is computed ONCE per bar (pure math, cheap) —
// no conditional calls and no duplication on the signal bar.
[bdMom, bdEr, bdVol, bdRsi, bdStruct, bdBreak] = calcScoreBreakdown(stTrend == 1, rsiLowestG, rsiHighestG)
float scoreAvailableMax = 50.0 + (useVolInput and hasVolume ? 17.0 : 0.0) + (useRsiInput ? 17.0 : 0.0) + (useStructureInput and (stTrend == 1 ? validLowPivot : validHighPivot) ? 16.0 : 0.0)
float bdTotal = 100.0 * (bdMom + bdEr + bdVol + bdRsi + bdStruct + bdBreak) / scoreAvailableMax

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6.5  REGIME BINS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
int curErBin   = erBin(erValue)
int curVolBin  = volBin(volRatio)
int curCellIdx = cellIdx(curErBin, curVolBin)

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7. SIGNAL LOGIC
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
float buyScore  = flipUp   ? bdTotal : 0.0
float sellScore = flipDown ? bdTotal : 0.0

// A single model position. Closed fields are retained until the next valid entry.
type TradeState
    int dir = 0
    int side = 0
    int entryBar = 0
    int entryTime = 0
    int cell = -1
    int epoch = 0
    float entry = na
    float sl = na
    float risk = na
    float tp1 = na
    float tp2 = na
    float tp3 = na
    float r1 = na
    float r2 = na
    float r3 = na
    bool hit1 = false
    bool hit2 = false
    bool hit3 = false
    float takenR = 0.0
    float costR = 0.0
    float remaining = 0.0
    float entryTqi = na
    float entryScore = na
    float entryScoreMax = na
    float signalPrice = na
    string id = ""
    string reason = ""
    string limitations = ""

var TradeState trade = TradeState.new()
array<string> barEvents = array.new<string>()
array<string> barNotes = array.new<string>()

method emitEvent(TradeState this, string kind, float level, float fill, float fraction, string reason) =>
    string eventId = INDICATOR_VERSION + ":" + this.id + ":" + str.tostring(time) + ":" + kind
    string payload = '{"event":' + jsonString(kind) + ',"event_id":' + jsonString(eventId) + ',"trade_id":' + jsonString(this.id) + ',"side":' + jsonString(this.side == 1 ? "long" : "short") + ',"bar_time":' + str.tostring(time) + ',"level_price":' + jsonNumber(level) + ',"fill_price":' + jsonNumber(fill) + ',"close_price":' + jsonNumber(close) + ',"fraction":' + jsonNumber(fraction) + ',"remaining":' + jsonNumber(this.remaining) + ',"realized_net_r":' + jsonNumber(this.takenR - this.costR) + ',"entry":' + jsonNumber(this.entry) + ',"sl":' + jsonNumber(this.sl) + ',"tp1":' + jsonNumber(this.tp1) + ',"tp2":' + jsonNumber(this.tp2) + ',"tp3":' + jsonNumber(this.tp3) + ',"score":' + jsonNumber(this.entryScore) + ',"tqi":' + jsonNumber(useTqiInput ? this.entryTqi : na) + ',"reason":' + jsonString(reason) + '}'
    array.push(barEvents, payload)
    array.push(barNotes, kind + " " + (this.side == 1 ? "LONG" : "SHORT") + " @ " + str.tostring(fill, format.mintick) + " (" + reason + ")")

method takeFill(TradeState this, float fill, float fraction) =>
    this.takenR += fraction * this.side * (fill - this.entry) / this.risk
    this.costR += fraction * math.abs(fill) * feePctInput / 100.0 / this.risk
    this.remaining := math.max(0.0, this.remaining - fraction)

var float lastM = na
var float lastE = na
var float lastV = na
var float lastR = na
var float lastS = na
var float lastB = na
var float lastScoreMax = na
var int lastDisplaySide = 0
var int lastSignalBar = 0
var string lastExitReason = "No completed trade"
var float lastExitR = na
var int lastExitTime = na
var string lastRejected = ""

bool confirmedBuy = false
bool confirmedSell = false
bool tp1Event = false
bool tp2Event = false
bool tp3Event = false
bool slEvent = false
bool timeoutFlag = false
bool flipExitFlag = false
bool closedThisBar = false
bool rawBuy = flipUp and barstate.isconfirmed and isWarmedUp
bool rawSell = flipDown and barstate.isconfirmed and isWarmedUp
bool confirmedCharFlip = charFlipFired and barstate.isconfirmed and isWarmedUp
int calculationEpoch = learn.epoch
float slipPrice = slippageTicksInput * syminfo.mintick

// First settle the OLD trade with this bar's full OHLC. SL wins ambiguous bars.
if trade.dir != 0 and barstate.isconfirmed and bar_index > trade.entryBar
    bool stopHit = trade.side == 1 ? low <= trade.sl : high >= trade.sl
    // Existing risk is managed even when readiness blocks NEW entries.
    bool opposite = trade.side != stTrend
    bool timedOut = bar_index - trade.entryBar >= tradeMaxAgeInput
    string exitReason = ""
    float exitFill = na
    if stopHit
        exitFill := (trade.side == 1 ? math.min(open, trade.sl) : math.max(open, trade.sl)) - trade.side * slipPrice
        float exiting = trade.remaining
        trade.takeFill(exitFill, exiting)
        slEvent := true
        exitReason := "SL"
        trade.emitEvent("sl_hit", trade.sl, exitFill, exiting, "Stop/gap; SL first on ambiguous OHLC")
    else
        if not trade.hit1 and (trade.side == 1 ? high >= trade.tp1 : low <= trade.tp1)
            trade.hit1 := true
            trade.takeFill(trade.tp1, 1.0 / 3.0)
            tp1Event := true
            trade.emitEvent("tp1_hit", trade.tp1, trade.tp1, 1.0 / 3.0, "Partial limit fill")
        if not trade.hit2 and (trade.side == 1 ? high >= trade.tp2 : low <= trade.tp2)
            trade.hit2 := true
            trade.takeFill(trade.tp2, 1.0 / 3.0)
            tp2Event := true
            trade.emitEvent("tp2_hit", trade.tp2, trade.tp2, 1.0 / 3.0, "Partial limit fill")
        if not trade.hit3 and (trade.side == 1 ? high >= trade.tp3 : low <= trade.tp3)
            trade.hit3 := true
            trade.takeFill(trade.tp3, trade.remaining)
            tp3Event := true
            exitReason := "TP3"
            exitFill := trade.tp3
            trade.emitEvent("tp3_hit", trade.tp3, trade.tp3, 1.0 / 3.0, "Final limit fill")
        else if opposite or timedOut
            exitFill := close - trade.side * slipPrice
            float exiting = trade.remaining
            trade.takeFill(exitFill, exiting)
            flipExitFlag := opposite
            timeoutFlag := not opposite
            exitReason := opposite ? "FLIP" : "TIMEOUT"
            trade.emitEvent(opposite ? "flip_exit" : "timeout_exit", close, exitFill, exiting, exitReason)
    if exitReason != ""
        lastExitReason := exitReason
        lastExitR := trade.takenR - trade.costR
        lastExitTime := time
        // Never clip losses: a stop gap and costs may exceed one initial R.
        learn.record(lastExitR, trade.cell, trade.epoch)
        trade.emitEvent("trade_closed", na, exitFill, 0.0, exitReason)
        trade.dir := 0
        closedThisBar := true

// Then validate and open the new position. Tick rounding is shared by every consumer.
if (rawBuy or rawSell) and trade.dir == 0
    int direction = rawBuy ? 1 : -1
    float newEntry = math.round_to_mintick(close + direction * slipPrice)
    bool pivotUsable = direction == 1 ? validLowPivot : validHighPivot
    float pivotBase = direction == 1 ? (pivotUsable ? lastPivotLow : low) : (pivotUsable ? lastPivotHigh : high)
    float buffer = effectiveSlMult * atrValue
    float cap = math.max(slMaxDistInput, effectiveSlMult) * atrValue
    float rawStop = direction == 1 ? math.max(math.min(pivotBase - buffer, newEntry - buffer), newEntry - cap) : math.min(math.max(pivotBase + buffer, newEntry + buffer), newEntry + cap)
    float newStop = direction == 1 ? roundDownTick(rawStop) : roundUpTick(rawStop)
    float newRisk = direction * (newEntry - newStop)
    // Tick distances preserve dynamic floors; reject if no tick fits the ceiling.
    float distance1 = math.max(syminfo.mintick, math.max(roundDownTick(newRisk * liveTp1R), useDynTp ? roundUpTick(newRisk * tp1Floor) : 0.0))
    float distance2 = math.max(distance1, math.max(roundDownTick(newRisk * liveTp2R), useDynTp ? roundUpTick(newRisk * tp2Floor) : 0.0))
    float distance3 = math.max(distance2, math.max(roundDownTick(newRisk * liveTp3R), useDynTp ? roundUpTick(newRisk * tp3Floor) : 0.0))
    float newTp1 = math.round_to_mintick(newEntry + direction * distance1)
    float newTp2 = math.round_to_mintick(newEntry + direction * distance2)
    float newTp3 = math.round_to_mintick(newEntry + direction * distance3)
    float tickTolerance = syminfo.mintick * 1e-6
    bool ceilingValid = not useDynTp or distance3 <= newRisk * dynTpCeilR3Input + tickTolerance
    bool stopLive = not na(newStop) and direction * (close - newStop) > tickTolerance
    bool levelsValid = stopLive and not na(newRisk) and newRisk >= minRiskTicksInput * syminfo.mintick - tickTolerance and direction * (newTp1 - newEntry) >= syminfo.mintick - tickTolerance and direction * (newTp2 - newTp1) >= -tickTolerance and direction * (newTp3 - newTp2) >= -tickTolerance and ceilingValid
    if levelsValid
        trade.dir := direction
        trade.side := direction
        trade.entryBar := bar_index
        trade.entryTime := time
        trade.entry := newEntry
        trade.signalPrice := close
        trade.sl := newStop
        trade.risk := newRisk
        trade.tp1 := newTp1
        trade.tp2 := newTp2
        trade.tp3 := newTp3
        trade.r1 := direction * (newTp1 - newEntry) / newRisk
        trade.r2 := direction * (newTp2 - newEntry) / newRisk
        trade.r3 := direction * (newTp3 - newEntry) / newRisk
        trade.hit1 := false
        trade.hit2 := false
        trade.hit3 := false
        trade.takenR := 0.0
        trade.costR := math.abs(newEntry) * feePctInput / 100.0 / newRisk
        trade.remaining := 1.0
        trade.cell := curCellIdx
        // These bands were calculated before an old-trade exit could change Q.
        trade.epoch := calculationEpoch
        trade.id := alertInstanceInput + ":" + syminfo.tickerid + ":" + timeframe.period + ":" + str.tostring(time) + ":" + str.tostring(direction)
        trade.entryTqi := tqi
        trade.entryScore := bdTotal
        trade.entryScoreMax := scoreAvailableMax
        bool viaPrice = direction == 1 ? priceFlipUp : priceFlipDown
        bool viaQuality = direction == 1 ? charFlipUp : charFlipDown
        trade.reason := viaPrice and viaQuality ? "Price break + quality collapse" : viaQuality ? "Quality collapse" : "Price band break"
        trade.limitations := (hasVolume ? "" : "Volume unavailable/flat; ") + (pivotUsable ? "" : "No recent valid pivot; ") + (newRisk >= cap ? "SL capped/rounded; " : "")
        confirmedBuy := direction == 1
        confirmedSell := direction == -1
        lastM := bdMom
        lastE := bdEr
        lastV := bdVol
        lastR := bdRsi
        lastS := bdStruct
        lastB := bdBreak
        lastScoreMax := scoreAvailableMax
        lastDisplaySide := direction
        lastSignalBar := bar_index
        lastRejected := ""
        trade.emitEvent(direction == 1 ? "buy" : "sell", close, newEntry, 1.0, trade.reason)
    else
        lastRejected := "Rejected " + (direction == 1 ? "BUY" : "SELL") + (not stopLive ? ": SL already breached at signal close after slippage" : ": invalid/sub-tick risk or targets")
else if rawBuy or rawSell
    lastRejected := "Entry skipped: model position is still active"

if confirmedCharFlip
    // Diagnostic event independent of trade ID, including when a new plan is invalid.
    array.push(barEvents, '{"event":"char_flip","event_id":' + jsonString(INDICATOR_VERSION + ":" + alertInstanceInput + ":" + syminfo.tickerid + ":" + timeframe.period + ":" + str.tostring(time) + ":char") + ',"bar_time":' + str.tostring(time) + ',"side":' + jsonString(stTrend == 1 ? "long" : "short") + ',"tqi":' + jsonNumber(tqi) + '}')
    array.push(barNotes, "Confirmed character flip")

float recentFlipCount = math.sum((flipUp or flipDown) ? 1.0 : 0.0, chopWindowInput)


// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 8. PLOTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
int lineTransp = showTqiColorInput and useTqiInput ? clampInt(int(math.round(mapClampInv(tqi, 0.1, 0.9, 70.0, 0.0))), 0, 100) : 0
color stLineColor = stTrend == 1 ? color.new(bullColorInput, lineTransp) : color.new(bearColorInput, lineTransp)

plot(showBandsInput and isWarmedUp ? stLine : na, "SuperTrend", color = stLineColor, linewidth = 2)

bgcolor(showBgInput and isWarmedUp ? (stTrend == 1 ? BULL_BG : BEAR_BG) : na, title = "Trend Background")

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 9. LABELS & SHAPES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
string scoreRefStr = "/" + str.tostring(MAX_SCORE_REF)
string tpModeTag = useDynTp ? "Dynamic ×" + str.tostring(dynScale, "0.00") : "Fixed"

if showSignalsInput and confirmedBuy
    label.new(bar_index, low, "▲ BUY  " + str.tostring(buyScore, "#"), color = bullColorInput, textcolor = LABEL_TEXT, style = label.style_label_up, size = size.small, tooltip = "SATS — BUY\nScore: " + str.tostring(buyScore, "#.0") + scoreRefStr + "\nTQI: " + str.tostring(tqi, "0.00") + "\nER: " + str.tostring(erValue, "0.00") + "\nRSI: " + str.tostring(rsiVal, "#.0") + "\nVol Z: " + str.tostring(volZ, "0.00") + "\nTP Mode: " + tpModeTag + "\nR: " + str.tostring(trade.r1, "0.00") + "/" + str.tostring(trade.r2, "0.00") + "/" + str.tostring(trade.r3, "0.00"))

if showSignalsInput and confirmedSell
    label.new(bar_index, high, "▼ SELL  " + str.tostring(sellScore, "#"), color = bearColorInput, textcolor = LABEL_TEXT, style = label.style_label_down, size = size.small, tooltip = "SATS — SELL\nScore: " + str.tostring(sellScore, "#.0") + scoreRefStr + "\nTQI: " + str.tostring(tqi, "0.00") + "\nER: " + str.tostring(erValue, "0.00") + "\nRSI: " + str.tostring(rsiVal, "#.0") + "\nVol Z: " + str.tostring(volZ, "0.00") + "\nTP Mode: " + tpModeTag + "\nR: " + str.tostring(trade.r1, "0.00") + "/" + str.tostring(trade.r2, "0.00") + "/" + str.tostring(trade.r3, "0.00"))

// ── Sniper-style TP/SL ──
var line  lineEntry = na
var line  lineSL    = na
var line  lineTp1   = na
var line  lineTp2   = na
var line  lineTp3   = na
var label lbEntry   = na
var label lbSL      = na
var label lbTp1     = na
var label lbTp2     = na
var label lbTp3     = na

if showRiskInput
    if (confirmedBuy or confirmedSell) and not na(trade.sl)
        line.delete(lineEntry)
        line.delete(lineSL)
        line.delete(lineTp1)
        line.delete(lineTp2)
        line.delete(lineTp3)
        label.delete(lbEntry)
        label.delete(lbSL)
        label.delete(lbTp1)
        label.delete(lbTp2)
        label.delete(lbTp3)

        int lineEnd  = bar_index + labelOffsetInput
        int labelPos = bar_index + labelOffsetInput + 2

        string tp1Lbl = "TP1 " + str.tostring(trade.tp1, format.mintick) + (useDynTp ? " (" + str.tostring(trade.r1, "#.0") + "R)" : "")
        string tp2Lbl = "TP2 " + str.tostring(trade.tp2, format.mintick) + (useDynTp ? " (" + str.tostring(trade.r2, "#.0") + "R)" : "")
        string tp3Lbl = "TP3 " + str.tostring(trade.tp3, format.mintick) + (useDynTp ? " (" + str.tostring(trade.r3, "#.0") + "R)" : "")

        lineEntry := line.new(bar_index, trade.entry, lineEnd, trade.entry, color = color.new(color.gray, 0), width = 2, style = line.style_solid)
        lineSL    := line.new(bar_index, trade.sl,    lineEnd, trade.sl,    color = slColorInput,             width = 2, style = line.style_solid)
        lineTp1   := line.new(bar_index, trade.tp1,   lineEnd, trade.tp1,   color = tpColorInput,             width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
        lineTp2   := line.new(bar_index, trade.tp2,   lineEnd, trade.tp2,   color = tpColorInput,             width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
        lineTp3   := line.new(bar_index, trade.tp3,   lineEnd, trade.tp3,   color = tpColorInput,             width = 2, style = line.style_dashed)

        lbEntry := label.new(labelPos, trade.entry, "ENTRY " + str.tostring(trade.entry, format.mintick), color = color.new(color.gray, 60), textcolor = TEXT_BRIGHT, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
        lbSL    := label.new(labelPos, trade.sl,    "SL "    + str.tostring(trade.sl,    format.mintick), color = color.new(slColorInput, 60), textcolor = TEXT_BRIGHT, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
        lbTp1   := label.new(labelPos, trade.tp1,   tp1Lbl, color = color.new(tpColorInput, 60), textcolor = TEXT_BRIGHT, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
        lbTp2   := label.new(labelPos, trade.tp2,   tp2Lbl, color = color.new(tpColorInput, 60), textcolor = TEXT_BRIGHT, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
        lbTp3   := label.new(labelPos, trade.tp3,   tp3Lbl, color = color.new(tpColorInput, 60), textcolor = TEXT_BRIGHT, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)

    else if trade.dir != 0 and not na(lineEntry)
        int newLineEnd  = bar_index + labelOffsetInput
        int newLabelPos = bar_index + labelOffsetInput + 2

        line.set_x2(lineEntry, newLineEnd)
        line.set_x2(lineSL, newLineEnd)
        line.set_x2(lineTp1, newLineEnd)
        line.set_x2(lineTp2, newLineEnd)
        line.set_x2(lineTp3, newLineEnd)

        label.set_x(lbEntry, newLabelPos)
        label.set_x(lbSL, newLabelPos)
        label.set_x(lbTp1, newLabelPos)
        label.set_x(lbTp2, newLabelPos)
        label.set_x(lbTp3, newLabelPos)

// Visuals consume events after the engine; never mutate trade accounting here.
if showRiskInput
    if (tp1Event or tp2Event or tp3Event) and not (confirmedBuy or confirmedSell)
        if tp1Event and showHitsInput and not na(lineTp1)
            line.set_color(lineTp1, HIT_COLOR)
            label.set_text(lbTp1, "TP1 HIT")
        if tp2Event and showHitsInput and not na(lineTp2)
            line.set_color(lineTp2, HIT_COLOR)
            label.set_text(lbTp2, "TP2 HIT")
        if tp3Event and showHitsInput and not na(lineTp3)
            line.set_color(lineTp3, HIT_COLOR)
            label.set_text(lbTp3, "TP3 HIT")
    if closedThisBar and not (confirmedBuy or confirmedSell) and not na(lbEntry)
        label.set_text(lbEntry, lastExitReason + " | " + signedR(lastExitR) + "R")
        label.set_color(lbEntry, color.new(color.gray, 60))
        line.set_color(lineEntry, color.gray)
        line.set_color(lineSL, color.gray)
        line.set_color(lineTp1, color.gray)
        line.set_color(lineTp2, color.gray)
        line.set_color(lineTp3, color.gray)
